issues.message: Only 30 blocks: too bare for a common (at least 50). Carlton wants more detail, not less.
Only 0 % of the blocks are detail blocks (stairs, slabs, trapdoors, fences, lanterns, flowers...). Aim for 20 %+.

visual.summary: Road level 1: a varied gravel, dirt and cobblestone patch, but it stands a full block above the grass like a platform.
problems: Still raised a whole block above the grass, which is exactly Carlton's note ("road is above ground now"). A road has to replace the ground: set meta.groundLayer 0 so layer 0 is level with the grass (the mod side then needs to dig the path in), or make it one layer of slabs/carpet-height blocks.
Level 1 has no detail blocks at all (the automatic check fails it): add the kerb slabs and a lamp from level 1.
